simple.meaning: תְּלִיתַי (tᵉlîythay) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “third.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 2:39. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּלִיתַי (H8523).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: תְּלִיתַי (tᵉlîythay) / H8523 is traced through Daniel 2:39, Daniel 5:7 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

timeline.evidenceText: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.
“After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, “Whoever reads this writing, and shows me its interpretation, shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.”

definitions.full: H8523. telithay תַּלְתִּי adjective denominative (only Biblical Aramaic) as substantive third (ruler), i.e. triumuir (M 89* ), compare foregoing, which possibly is abnormal form of same (K § 65, 1, Anm.3 ), Dan 5:7 . [ תְּלִיתַי ] adjective third ( תְּלִיתַי ᵑ7 , Syriac ); — feminine תְּלִיתָיָא Kt, תָאָה - Qr (K § 11, 1 b )) Dan 2:39 the third kingdom .
